**IT BUSINESS ANALYST**

**ENTERPRISE DATA \& ANALYTICS**

**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER**. It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

**The Team**


As part of the Global Technology Organization, the aim of Enterprise Data and Analytics (ED\&A) team is to enable Mattel as a data\-driven organization, by:

* Delivering high quality data for self\-service analytics and data science via a modern data infrastructure that supports our business partners and aligns with business strategy.

* Provide training to business users on our data and reporting/visualization tools (ThoughtSpot, Tableau, IBM Cognos Analytics, Google BigQuery, Collibra).
* Actively contribute to adding value to business partners’ organizations by proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.

**What It’s Like to Work Here**

* **We collaborate:** Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* **We innovate:** At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* **We execute:** We are a performance driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best in class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

 **What We’re Looking For:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business or related field. MBA is a plus.
* 2\+ years of experience as a business analyst, data product manager or in a similar position.
* Professional level understanding of general business processes and functions, with capability to analyze and document proposals for data products aligned with organizational goals and reference architecture.
* Demonstrable experience in working with data and databases required – Google Cloud Platform/BigQuery would be a significant advantage.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Context Serving, Data Context Layer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This role is part of a broader enterprise initiative to establish a
 **Data Context Layer (DCL)** 
 — a foundational capability designed to provide consistent, reusable, and scalable context across enterprise data products.
   

  

 The DCL is intended to address challenges related to
 **data fragmentation, lack of shared semantics, and inconsistent interpretation of data across systems and products** 
 . It establishes a unified layer for representing context, relationships, and meaning, enabling downstream products to operate with greater consistency, interoperability, and intelligence.
   

  

 In addition, the DCL plays a critical role in enabling
 **agentic AI capabilities across the enterprise** 
 by providing the structured context and semantic grounding required for intelligent agents to operate reliably. This includes ensuring that agent\-driven workflows and decisions are based on
 **consistent, governed, and interpretable data context** 
 , reducing risks associated with fragmentation, ambiguity, and lack of control.
   

  

 Within this initiative, the Associate Director – Product Manager, Context Serving. will own the
 **product definition, development, and evolution of core context serving capabilities** 
 . These capabilities form the backbone for how context is consumed across multiple products and platforms, and will be central to enabling
 **governed, scalable, and reusable intelligent systems** 
 .
   

  

 The role operates at the intersection of
 **product, architecture, and enterprise platforms** 
 , working closely with Enterprise Architecture, platform teams, and product leadership to build
 **enterprise\-grade context capabilities that support both traditional data products and emerging AI\-driven use cases** 
 .
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a Product Manager to own a single, high\-impact capability within our enterprise data context platform
 **self\-service serving of standardized data context** 
 . This role will focus on defining, building, and scaling one core capability that enables teams to publish, discover, and consume data context consistently across the enterprise.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has strong product instincts, technical fluency in data/semantic systems, and experience partnering with engineering and architecture teams to deliver a platform capability from definition through production adoption. This role also requires working knowledge of
 **agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering** 
 concepts, particularly as they relate to delivering reliable, reusable context for AI\-enabled applications.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the product vision, requirements, and roadmap for the assigned capability within the context platform.
* Define how the capability supports standardized, self\-service serving of data context.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, and governance teams to translate standards into implementable product requirements.
* Ensure the capability is intuitive for users and scalable for enterprise adoption.
* Define workflows for
+ publishing context
+ discovering context
+ consuming context through approved interfaces
+ validating and maintaining context quality

* Collaborate with adjacent platform teams to ensure the capability integrates cleanly with broader context, metadata, and governance services.
* Work with stakeholders to prioritize features, resolve tradeoffs, and drive adoption.
* Define success metrics such as usage, reuse, quality, and time\-to\-onboard.
* Support the transition of the capability from development into production, including release readiness, documentation, and operational requirements.
* Help shape how the capability supports agentic AI workflows, including reliable context delivery for prompts, tools, skills, and AI assistants.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of product management experience in technical products, data platforms, or enterprise software.
* Ability to work closely with engineering teams on platform or infrastructure capabilities.
* Familiarity with data context, metadata, ontology, or semantic concepts.
* Working knowledge of agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering concepts.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience defining requirements for self\-service or platform capabilities.

**B Corp certified in multiple markets**

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Product Expert to drive AI innovation, strategic communication, and effective change management within the organization. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of AI technologies, storytelling, and how to leverage AI products to solve business challenges. This role will be pivotal in shaping our AI strategy, guiding teams on the best use of AI tools, managing vendor relationships, and leading innovation projects. You will be instrumental in driving AI adoption across the organization, ensuring smooth integration of embedded AI solutions, and running rapid prototyping on POCs.
   

  

**Job Highlights \& Main Responsibilities**
* Strategic Role: Shape the AI strategy and provide the organization with insights on when and how to integrate AI products.
* Innovation Focus: Lead innovation projects and be the bridge between AI development and organizational needs.
* AI Expertise: Stay ahead of AI trends and market developments, applying an “outside\-in” perspective to ensure we are leveraging the most relevant tools.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the organization to create synergy in AI product usage.
* Vendor Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with AI product vendors and partners.


**Main Responsibilities**
* AI Product Strategy \& Storytelling:
+ Develop and communicate a clear AI strategy, aligning with business goals and driving AI adoption across departments.
+ Craft compelling narratives around AI technologies, showcasing their impact and potential value to various stakeholders.
+ Lead the development of AI storytelling frameworks to simplify complex AI concepts for non\-technical audiences.

* Change Management \& Embedded AI:
+ Champion change management initiatives for AI adoption, ensuring smooth integration of AI solutions in the organization.
+ Partner with key departments to identify areas where AI can bring immediate value and lead the implementation of embedded AI products.

* Innovation Projects \& Rapid Prototyping:
+ Lead and manage AI innovation projects from ideation to execution.
+ Drive rapid prototyping of POCs to test new AI concepts, quickly validating and iterating on ideas.
+ Foster a culture of experimentation, quickly adopting new AI technologies to address business needs.

* Vendor Management \& External Relations:
+ Build and maintain relationships with external AI vendors and partners, ensuring access to the latest tools and technologies.
+ Collaborate with vendors to evaluate and implement AI products that align with business requirements.
+ Negotiate contracts, manage vendor deliverables, and ensure smooth integration of third\-party AI products into existing systems.

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration:
+ Act as the AI ambassador within the organization, providing guidance on when to use what AI products and how to maximize their value.
+ Work closely with product, marketing, data, and engineering teams to create a cohesive AI roadmap and ensure alignment on objectives.
+ Coordinate across departments to ensure the successful deployment and scaling of AI\-driven initiatives.

* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a high\-performing Sales Manager to drive business growth across South Zone. The ideal candidate will have strong on\-ground sales execution capability, an existing network in the physiotherapy and rehabilitation space, and the ability to communicate fluently with local healthcare professionals and institutions. This is a revenue\-critical, field\-focused role requiring deep market penetration across clinics, hospitals, and rehabilitation centres in the South India.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Sales \& Revenue Generation** 




 Achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for the assigned territory.
 



 Identify, prospect, and convert new customers including physiotherapy clinics, rehabilitation centres, hospitals, orthopaedic departments, and sports medicine facilities etc.
 



  





 Manage the complete sales cycle — from lead generation and product demonstration to negotiation and order closure.
 



  





 Maintain an updated sales pipeline in CRM tools and provide accurate revenue forecasts to leadership.
 



 Drive aggressive territory expansion by identifying untapped micro\-markets within the assigned geography.
 



  





**2\. Key Account \& Relationship Management** 



* Build and nurture long\-term relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), physiotherapists, orthopaedic surgeons, and institutional procurement heads.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for key accounts — ensuring high customer satisfaction, retention, and repeat business.
* Conduct regular follow\-up visits and clinical reviews to strengthen engagement and identify upsell / cross\-sell opportunities.
* Develop referral pipelines through satisfied customers and clinical champions.



  





**3\. Product Promotion \& Market Development** 



* Conduct in\-clinic product demonstrations, hands\-on trials, and group workshops to educate healthcare professionals on the clinical benefits of PEMF and rehabilitation devices.
* Prepare and deliver customised value propositions based on the customer’s clinical needs and buying motives.
* Maintain deep product knowledge to handle clinical queries, objections, and competitive comparisons confidently.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to plan and execute CMEs (Continuing Medical Education events), conferences, webinars, and product launch activities in the territory.
* Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and customer feedback; relay insights to the product and marketing teams.
* Develop and support distributor/dealer networks, ensuring alignment with company sales strategy and brand standards.



  





**4\. Reporting \& Compliance** 



* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, sales activities, and competitive intelligence in the CRM system.
* Submit daily call reports, expense statements, and monthly sales review dashboards on time.
* Ensure all sales activities comply with medical device regulations, company ethics policies, and applicable legal standards.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Physiotherapy, Biomedical Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA preferred but not mandatory.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of experience in medical device or healthcare sales.
* Prior experience in physiotherapy, orthopaedic, or rehabilitation equipment is a strong advantage.
* Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding sales targets.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills — ability to communicate both clinical and commercial value effectively.
* Excellent interpersonal and relationship\-building skills, comfortable engaging with clinical as well as administrative stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated, target\-driven, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and familiarity with CRM platforms preferred.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive fixed CTC with an attractive performance\-linked incentive structure tied directly to revenue achievement.
* Monthly travel allowance and expense reimbursement as per company policy.
* Comprehensive product and clinical training with ongoing field support.
* A dynamic, results\-driven culture with strong leadership visibility and fast career progression.
* Clear pathways to Senior Sales Manager, Regional Manager, or National Sales leadership roles based on performance.

jobs.title: AI/Gen AI Engineer- Senior Manager
jobs.description:
**The role** 




 You own the AIOps managed services engagement end\-to\-end: the forward\-deployed engineering team, the broader run organization it leverages, the operating model, the executive client relationship, and the commercial outcome — the year\-over\-year takeout that defines the deal. You lead across all disciplines: Build \& Deploy, Operations, and Observability \& SRE.
 



 This is the role that makes a lean expert core leverage a large delivery footprint — and proves it. You set strategy, lead the leaders, own the economics, own the innovation operating model, and build the capability so the model stamps onto the next account.
 



**About PwC AIOps** 




 PwC’s AIOps runs the client’s operations with intelligence built in: we deploy PwC’s agentic platforms and automation accelerators into the client’s environment and operate them in production — taking cost out of the run while improving service quality, measured and sustained year over year. This is broader than the classic “AI for IT operations”; it is operating a workforce of agents and automations that do the work, with the engineering discipline to keep them reliable and to prove the value. Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are embedded with the client — high\-agency, ship\-to\-production engineers who own outcomes rather than tickets, sitting close to the work and building what is needed.
 



 AIOps is delivered across three disciplines that work as one loop. Build \& Deploy ships the work\-doers — AI agents for judgment\- and language\-heavy tasks, and deterministic automation for high\-volume, rules\-based work; the two go hand in hand, chosen by whichever is the faster, safer path to takeout. Operations (AgentOps) keeps the deployed fleet trustworthy through evaluation, guardrails, drift detection, and incident response — what lets a lean core safely operate an ever\-growing footprint. Observability \& SRE instruments the estate to find the toil, cut the noise, and quantify the efficiency delivered. Build creates capability, AgentOps keeps it reliable, and Observability finds the next opportunity and proves the last.
 



 Efficiency compounds because we run a flywheel, not a project: observe to locate toil and cost, build or automate it away, operate it reliably so it scales without adding heads, prove the takeout, and reinvest the freed capacity into the next opportunity — so value scales with the fleet, not headcount. Operate is not “keep the lights on”: a disciplined innovation cadence runs inside delivery — daily intake, value\-based prioritization, rapid build, and measured results, governed jointly with the client — making the operate layer the client’s continuous\-improvement and step\-change engine. Every role contributes to, and is measured against, that year\-over\-year takeout.
 



**What you’ll do** 




**Engagement ownership** 



* Own the engagement roadmap, delivery, quality, and the commercial result — margin and the contracted takeout curve.
* Set the technical and delivery strategy across all three disciplines; make the build/run/automate trade\-offs that protect economics.
* Own the operating model that lets a small expert core leverage a large run organization.



**Client leadership** 



* Own the executive client relationship; be the trusted advisor on their AIOps transformation.
* Own and tell the value story — instrument, quantify, and defend the efficiency delivered year over year.



**Innovation \& continuous improvement** 



* Own the operate\-level innovation engine — the intake → prioritize → build → measure cadence — so the engagement delivers step\-change, not just steady\-state.
* Chair, with the client, the innovation council / value\-realization governance that prioritizes the backlog and approves agent autonomy gates.



**Leading leaders** 



* Lead the Managers across Build, Operations, and Observability; coach them as leaders.
* Build the capability: recruit, develop, and retain FDE talent; codify the pod model for reuse.



**Growth** 



* Identify expansion; shape proposals and SOWs; contribute to the broader AI Managed Services go\-to\-market.
* Contribute thought leadership that builds the practice’s reputation.



**Risk \& governance** 



* Own risk, quality, and independence for the engagement within PwC’s framework — including data handling and the gated\-autonomy controls that keep production safe in regulated environments.



**What you’ll bring** 



* 12\+ years across software/AI engineering and delivery, with significant time leading multi\-team or multi\-workstream organizations.
* Deep technical credibility (agents, automation, observability) combined with proven delivery leadership.
* Experience owning client relationships and commercial outcomes in consulting, managed services, or comparable client delivery.
* Strong people leadership: building, coaching, and retaining high\-performing engineering teams.
* Executive communication — able to move between a CIO conversation and an architecture review.
* Commercial fluency: P\&L/margin, estimation, scoping, and value articulation.



**Nice to have** 



* Prior managed or professional services leadership.
* Experience standing up a new delivery capability; published thought leadership.



**Leadership profile — what sets this level apart** 



* Sets vision and operating model, not just delivery.
* Develops other leaders and builds bench.
* Owns the room with client executives and the PwC partnership.
* Balances delivery, economics, talent, and risk simultaneously.



**What success looks like (first 6–12 months)** 



* The engagement is delivering to its takeout curve, on margin.
* The leadership tier is strong and growing.
* The client sees PwC as the partner for their AIOps transformation.
* The pod model is documented and ready to replicate.

jobs.description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission\-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments \- creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Senior Technical Architect (Application Modernization)**
 We are seeking a visionary Technical Architect with a deep background in Application Modernization to lead a critical digital transformation. This role is focused on deconstructing a legacy 2\-tier architecture and rebuilding it into a scalable, high\-performance N\-tier system.
   

  

 You will be the bridge between the past and the future—moving our logic out of SQL stored procedures and migrating our legacy C\# frontend into a modern, responsive React/Redux ecosystem.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Architectural Strategy: Define the roadmap for migrating a monolithic 2\-tier application (Client/Server) to a decoupled, N\-tier architecture.
* Legacy Deconstruction: Analyze legacy C\# codebases and complex SQL stored procedures to identify business logic for extraction.
* Modernization Execution: Lead the shift of business logic from the database layer into a dedicated C\#/.NET Business Logic Layer (BLL) or Microservices.
* Frontend Leadership: Direct the transition from legacy UI to a modern React.js frontend, utilizing Redux for robust state management using Vite, Material UI, Redux Toolkit, React Query, React Hook Form, and Styled Components/SCSS.
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility, visual consistency, and WCAG accessibility compliance.
* API Design: Architect and implement secure, RESTful APIs that serve as the communication backbone between the new frontend and the re\-engineered backend.
* Technical Governance: Establish coding standards, design patterns (e.g., Repository, Unit of Work), and CI/CD pipelines tailored for modernization projects.


**Technical Requirements**
 Category Requirements Modernization Proven experience moving logic from Stored Procedures to Application Code (Refactoring the "Smart Database" anti\-pattern). Frontend Expert\-level proficiency in React.js, Redux / Redux Toolkit, Vite, Material UI, React Query, React Hook Form, and Styled Components/SCSS and modern CSS frameworks (Bootstrap). Backend Strong mastery of C\# and .NET (6/7/8/9\+), specifically in building Web APIs and Service Layers (must have strong hands\-on experience in RestSharp, Dapper, Fluent Validations etc.). Database Deep understanding of SQL Server; ability to read/debug complex legacy T\-SQL and optimize new schemas. Architecture Solid grasp of N\-tier architecture, Dependency Injection, and Microservices patterns. Cloud/Containerization Expert\-level proficiency in Cloud (Azure), Docker and Kubernetes. Cache Mechanism Strong mastery in Redis for Cache Management
   

  

**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Modernization Veteran: 15\+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5\+ years specifically leading Legacy\-to\-Modern migration projects.
* The "2\-to\-N" Specialist: Demonstrated success in breaking down 2\-tier "Fat Client" or "Fat DB" systems into modular N\-tier environments.
* Strategic Thinker: Ability to balance "perfect" architecture with business continuity.
* Communication: Ability to explain technical debt and architectural ROI to stakeholders who may only see the UI changes.
* Industry certifications would definitely be considered.

**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineering Lead  

**Project Role Description :** Own the technical direction and architecture of custom software solutions, leading teams through design and delivery. Set development standards and ensure code quality, scalability, and performance aligned to business objectives.
  

**Must have skills :** Software Architectures  

**Good to have skills :** NA

Senior Software Architect \& Developer  

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands\-on Senior Software Architect / Senior Developer to design, build, and guide the development of our next\-generation market infrastructure for fund distribution, leveraging cloud\-native, microservice, and blockchain/DLT technologies.  

  

This hybrid role combines deep architectural leadership with pragmatic, high\-quality engineering. As a senior technical authority, you will define architectural patterns, mentor engineers, participate in code design and delivery, and ensure our software platform is scalable, secure, and future\-proof.  

  

The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and a strong coder, comfortable making architecture decisions while contributing directly to implementation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement across squads.  

  

Your responsibilities include  

  

Architecture \& Technical Leadership  

Define, evolve, and maintain the technical architecture of a complex cloud\-native, microservice\-based platform.  

Drive key architectural decisions, ensuring alignment with product vision, scalability needs, and regulatory requirements.  

Produce architectural diagrams, reference designs, integration patterns, and API/interface definitions.  

Partner closely with the Product Architect to ensure technical design matches functional domain models.  

  

Hands\-On Design \& Development  

Contribute directly to development of core services, components, and libraries in the platform.  

Lead complex feature implementations, ensuring code quality, testability, and performance.  

Review code, mentor developers, and drive best practices across teams.  

Provide expert guidance on system design, data flows, resilience strategies, and performance optimization.  

  

Cloud\-Native Engineering \& DevOps Collaboration  

Support the adoption of cloud\-native best practices such as containerization, service mesh, IaC, and observability.  

Collaborate with DevOps to optimize CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, and runtime configurations.  

Ensure that infrastructure and application design supports high availability, automated scaling, and robust monitoring.  

  

Blockchain / DLT Integration  

Design and support integration points between on\-chain and off\-chain services (smart contracts, event listeners, tokenization flows).  

Collaborate with blockchain engineers and Product Architects to ensure consistent, auditable, and performant DLT interactions.  

Support long\-term evolution of blockchain usage and its alignment with business needs.  

  

Security, Compliance \& Quality  

Champion secure\-by\-design principles, encryption patterns, access control models, and auditability.  

Conduct threat modelling, identify potential vulnerabilities, and guide remediation strategies.  

Ensure development practices meet the reliability, resilience, and regulatory expectations of financial market infrastructure.  

  

Cross\-Team Collaboration \& Mentoring  

Act as a senior technical partner to Product Owners, Business Analysts, and QA engineers.  

Mentor junior and mid\-level developers, promoting strong engineering culture and continuous learning.  

Assist in troubleshooting complex production issues and conducting root\-cause analyses.  

Support alignment across squads when implementing cross\-cutting features or shared components.  

  

Key skills  

  

Strong proficiency in one or more backend languages (e.g., Java, Kotlin, Scala, Go, Rust, Node.js, or similar).  

Expertise in cloud\-native architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and distributed systems.  

Solid experience with microservices, event\-driven architectures, APIs (REST/GraphQL), and messaging systems.  

Good understanding of blockchain/DLT concepts, smart contracts, and integration patterns (highly preferred).  

Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases, data modeling, and performance optimization.  

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and observability tooling.  

Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to break down complex technical challenges.  

Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across teams.  

  

Required experience  

7–12\+ years of software engineering experience, including several years in senior or lead roles.  

Proven experience designing and delivering complex distributed systems in cloud\-native environments.  

Hands\-on experience implementing microservices at scale, ideally in fintech or financial services.  

Prior exposure to blockchain/DLT systems is a strong advantage.  

Demonstrated ability to combine architectural thinking with hands\-on coding and technical design.  

Experience mentoring engineers and influencing engineering practices across multiple teams.  

Experience working in Agile, multi\-squad environments with strong delivery cadence.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst – Treasury
jobs.description:
**About DESRI**
 DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market\-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 11\.9 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 80 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, and Hyderabad (India).
   

  

 We are looking for a resourceful and driven professional to join DESRI, based out of the firm’s Hyderabad, India office. The successful candidate will be a part of a small, inclusive, highly skilled team responsible for supporting DESRI’s portfolio of wind, solar and battery projects in an agile environment that values collaboration, thoughtful problem solving, and attention to detail.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 You will work on a wide variety of Treasury and Corporate Finance initiatives, with a substantial focus on Treasury, managing our project\-level debt facilities, and Financial Planning and Analysis (FP\&A).
   

  

 On the Treasury side, you will be responsible for coordinating and administering various cash payments and receipts on DESRI’s 80\+ solar and wind projects and financing corporate entities, while always ensuring the adequacy of funds. Additionally, you will work with various stakeholders, including bankers, investors, senior management, asset managers, and the accounting team, to ensure that the cash side of the business is functioning efficiently while continuously developing and implementing process improvements. Furthermore, you will be responsible for preparing periodic reports for the financing parties and senior management.
   

  

 On the FP\&A side, you will be responsible for forecasting DESRI’s short\-term and long\-term cash position, both at the project and corporate levels, tracking overall deal flow, planning for upcoming significant fundings, identifying and alleviating liquidity and covenant compliance concerns, and optimizing distributions. You will also potentially work on other areas of corporate finance, such as working with lenders, investors, counsel, and senior management on the initiation, modeling, due diligence, closing, and ongoing compliance of corporate financing facilities.
   

  

 Additionally, this position offers an opportunity to work on initiatives related to establishing, standardizing, optimizing, and documenting treasury processes, workflows, and controls.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate should hold –
   

  

* Education: Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Finance or a Chartered Accountant (CA) degree
* Experience: 2\-4 years in Treasury, Corporate Finance, FP\&A, or Accounting\-related functions
* Skills: Proficiency in cash flow modeling and forecasting; experience with Treasury management, debt facility administration, and FP\&A; ability to work with and enhance financial planning tools; strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; effective written and verbal communication skills; ability to develop strong partnerships and influence stakeholders across teams.
* Work Style: Ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively with teams located across different time zones and jurisdictions.
* Preferred Qualifications: Prior experience in the renewable energy sector

**Product Development Manager — AI Applications, Platform Engineering \& DevOps**

**Job Summary**

Mardamed is seeking a highly skilled and hands\-on technology leader to manage the end\-to\-end development, deployment, enhancement, and operational excellence of the Mardamed application ecosystem. The ideal candidate will combine modern AI\-assisted software development expertise with strong platform engineering, systems integration, cloud architecture, and DevOps capabilities.

This role will be responsible for driving rapid innovation using AI\-powered development platforms such as Lovable, Claude, Cursor, Replit, and related tools while ensuring enterprise\-grade reliability, security, scalability, and user experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Development \& Delivery**

* Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement of the Mardamed platform.
* Own the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) from requirements gathering through production deployment.
* Drive Agile development practices and manage product backlogs, sprints, releases, and feature roadmaps.
* Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality software releases.

**AI\-Assisted Development**

* Leverage AI development platforms including Lovable, Claude, Cursor, Replit, and similar tools to accelerate development and improve productivity.
* Design, optimize, and maintain advanced prompts, workflows, and AI\-assisted development processes.
* Establish best practices for AI\-driven software engineering and code generation.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging AI tools that improve product quality and development efficiency.

**Systems Integration**

* Architect and manage integrations with third\-party healthcare and business platforms.

**Cloud, Infrastructure \& Deployment**

* Design and manage hybrid and cloud\-native deployments across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Establish deployment pipelines across Development, UAT, Staging, and Production environments.

**DevOps \& Operational Excellence**

* Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines.
* Maintain source control and project workflows using GitHub and Jira.
* Establish monitoring, alerting, logging, backup, disaster recovery, and incident management practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of software development experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing end\-to\-end application development and deployment lifecycles.
* Strong expertise in cloud platforms, DevOps, APIs, integrations, GitHub, Jira, and AI\-assisted development.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare technology and healthcare systems integration.
* Experience with PACS, RIS, LIS, pharmacy, billing, and payment systems.
* Strong prompt engineering and AI workflow design expertise.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Microsoft Advertising, part of Microsoft AI (MAI), is a rapidly growing business powering global advertisers across search, display, and emerging AI\-driven channels. Our Advertising CRM team is building the next generation of customer relationship management solutions that unify advertiser data, enable intelligent workflows, and deliver actionable insights across Sales, Marketing, Operations, Billing, and Customer Success.


We are seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** passionate about AI innovation, Copilot experiences, Dynamics 365 CRM, and full\-stack engineering to help drive the transformation from OneCRM to TrueCRM. In this role, you will build scalable cloud\-native solutions, introduce AI\-powered capabilities, and deliver modern customer experiences that empower thousands of sellers, marketers, and business users worldwide.


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.


Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50\- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25\-mile commute of a non\-U.S., country\-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Design, develop, and operate scalable, secure, and highly available full\-stack solutions supporting Microsoft Advertising CRM platforms.
* Build modern web applications, APIs, and cloud\-native services using Azure technologies for sales enablement and advertiser lifecycle management.
* Leverage Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, Dataverse, and Power Platform to deliver customer engagement, workflow automation, and business process solutions.
* Contribute to the evolution of the CRM ecosystem and transformation from OneCRM to TrueCRM, driving modernization and improved user experiences.
* Develop and integrate AI\-powered capabilities, including Copilot experiences, intelligent recommendations, conversational workflows, predictive insights, and automation.
* Partner with Product Managers, Applied Scientists, Data Scientists, and engineers to deliver innovative, customer\-centric solutions.
* Build scalable backend services, distributed systems, APIs, and data platforms using Azure cloud services and modern engineering practices.
* Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, testing automation, observability, reliability, security, and performance optimization.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies including Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLMs, Copilot extensibility, and intelligent automation frameworks.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience building enterprise\-scale applications and cloud services.

We are looking for programmers with a keen eye for design for the position of a front\-end developer. Front\-end developers are responsible for ensuring the alignment of web design and user experience requirements, optimizing web pages for maximum efficiency, and maintaining brand consistency across all web pages, among other duties.

  

Front\-end developers are required to work in teams alongside back\-end developers, graphic designers, and user experience designers to ensure all elements of web creation are consistent. This requires excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

We are headquartered in the United States with branch offices in Dubai, India, and now, Ukraine. A technology company in IT services, we have multiple product companies within ATC.

  

Through **ATC Ventures****,** we fund inventive entrepreneurs with a passion for SaaS products and have built multiple tech startups from the ground up.

  

With our startup incubator, **Startup Studios**, we partner with entrepreneurs and businesses to build products that solve everyday problems through the creative use of technology. We nurture client efficiency not only through the custom products we build for their organizations but with the automation opportunities we identify through expert business analysis.

  

Some of the product companies under ATC:

* UnboxedMagazine
* ATC Animation Studios

Software Engineer/Sr.Software Engineer

* Use markup languages like HTML to create user\-friendly web pages
* Maintain and improve website
* Optimize applications for maximum speed
* Design mobile\-based features
* Collaborate with back\-end developers and web designers to improve the usability
* Experience in front\-end technologies (e.g. JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and JQuery)
* Ability to develop highly interactive as well as user\-friendly applications
* A strong passion for writing simple, clean, and efficient code
* An analytical mind in addition to a problem\-solving attitude
* Ability to take quick decisions while working independently
* Writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code
* Contributing to all phases of the software development lifecycle
* Designing robust, secure, and scalable features
* Driving continuous integration of relevant new technologies and upgrades into design
* Following the best\-established practices such as test\-driven development, SCRUM, continuous integration, refactoring, and code standards

 **Qualification and experience required:**

* Proven work experience as a Front\-end developer
* Hands\-on experience with markup languages
* Experience with JavaScript, CSS, and jQuery

* In\-depth understanding of the entire web development process (design, development, and deployment)
* Understanding of layout aesthetics
* Knowledge of SEO principles

* An ability to perform well in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent analytical and multitasking skills
* BSc degree in Computer Science or relevant field

 **How you’ll grow**


Our professional development framework focuses on helping people at every level of their careers to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. We have a clearly defined career road map from entry\-level employees to senior leadership positions.


Our dual\-career road map provides opportunities to grow as an individual contributor or as a people leader to suit your strengths and the context of business growth.

Where you work is as important as why you work. We are committed to an employee\-centric atmosphere that drives fulfillment and encourages an enriching and collaborative culture of advanced and engaging professionals. We operate in an onshore/ offshore model, we have teams that work in multiple time zones. We expect our employees to be available to work extended/flexible hours and/or be available on weekends as needed to deliver the best for our stakeholders and clients.

Every interview at ATC will have at least four rounds of assessments, such as:

jobs.description:
**About Atos Group**
 Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 56,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7\.2 billion (at the go\-forward perimeter), operating in 54 countries under two brands \- Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI\-powered, end\-to\-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is the brand under which Atos SE (Societas Europaea) operates. Atos SE listed on Euronext Paris.
   

  

 The purpose of Atos Group is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to define and drive the AI and Agentic AI vision for
 **Atos’ Digital Workplace (DWP) services offerings** 
 . This role owns the
 **product roadmap, value narrative, and market positioning** 
 for AI\-enabled workplace offerings—spanning Service Desk, End User Computing, Collaboration, Digital Experience, and Workplace Operations.
   

  

 The Product Manager will work closely with AI architects and delivery teams who support the underlying technical strategy, while this role focuses on
 **vision, prioritization, road mapping, and client engagement** 
 . Success is measured by solution developed, roadmap achievement, solution adoption, client impact, and differentiation. The candidate will need to bring enterprise level agentic capabilities to our Digital Workplace customers. We already have more than 25\+ AI agents in our backlog, and looking at more use cases that can be rapidly brought to our customer environments to drive autonomy, improve quality, increase speed to delivery and ultimately achieve the vision our customers and the market has been waiting for
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
**AI roadmap for Atos’ Digital Workplace offerings**
 Own the AI and Agentic AI vision across Atos Digital Workplace services, including Service Desk, EUC, Collaboration, Digital Employee Experience, and Workplace Operations. Position AI as a core driver of productivity, experience, and cost efficiency across the portfolio. Ensure the vision aligns with Atos strategy, market trends, and client transformation priorities.
   

  

**Roadmap Ownership Across DWP Services**
 Define and maintain an integrated, multi\-horizon AI roadmap across all Digital Workplace service lines. Prioritize high\-impact use cases such as agentic Service Desk, workplace copilots, AI\-driven experience insights, and operational automation. Clearly communicate sequencing, trade\-offs, and value to senior stakeholders and clients.
   

  

**Client Engagement \& Executive Storytelling**
 Act as a primary product voice in client and executive engagements for AI\-enabled Digital Workplace offerings. Present AI roadmaps, demos, and future\-state visions to CXO audiences, supporting pursuits, renewals, and transformations. Translate complex AI capabilities into simple, outcome\-focused narratives that build credibility and confidence.
   

  

**Agentic AI Use\-Case Definition for Workplace Services**
 Define where and how agentic AI enhance core workplace workflows, including Service Desk interactions, knowledge access, device support, and collaboration. Set experience\-level requirements for autonomy, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and trust. Partner with architects and UX teams to guide solution design without owning technical implementation.
   

  

**Responsible AI \& Adoption at Enterprise Scale**
 Embed responsible AI principles into product vision and roadmap decisions to ensure enterprise readiness. Drive adoption strategies covering change management, enablement, and measurable outcomes across clients. Ensure AI solutions enhance employee trust, service quality, and experience.
   

  

**Stakeholder Alignment \& Portfolio Performance**
 Serve as the central point of alignment across Digital Workplace leadership, architects, delivery, and go\-to\-market teams. Track success through adoption, Service Desk deflection, experience scores (XLAs), productivity impact, and client satisfaction. Provide clear updates to senior leadership and refine strategy based on performance and market feedback.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 3\+ years of product management experience in AI, Digital Workplace, IT services, or enterprise platforms.
* Strong experience owning product vision, roadmaps, and client\-facing narratives.
* Solid understanding of Digital Workplace services such as Service Desk, EUC, Collaboration, and DEX.
* Conceptual knowledge of AI products (copilots, agentic workflows, RAG) sufficient to guide strategy and prioritization.
* Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.


**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience with AI\-enabled Service Desk or workplace automation at scale.
* Background in consulting, managed services, or global enterprise delivery models.
* Familiarity with ITSM, XLAs, and Digital Employee Experience platforms.
* Experience working with architects and platform teams rather than owning technical delivery.
* Agile or product management certifications (CSPO, Pragmatic, SAFe).

jobs.title: Product Manager- Plum
jobs.description:
**About This Role**
 We're looking for a Product Manager to own the product roadmap for Plum — from defining what gets built to ensuring it ships and lands well with customers. You'll sit at the intersection of technology, design, sales, and customer care, and be responsible for the full lifecycle of product features: discovery, prioritisation, development, and launch.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role suited to someone with 2–5 years of product management experience in a product company, who is comfortable working across both technical and business contexts.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Product Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Define and maintain the product roadmap, balancing customer needs, business value, and development capacity
* Develop business cases for new features, including feasibility analysis, addressable market, SWOT assessment, and estimated costs
* Research competitive offerings in the market and use insights to inform prioritisation decisions


**Discovery \& Requirements**
* Engage with customers regularly to surface problems, validate assumptions, and translate findings into product direction
* Write clear functional, technical, and design specifications that development and design teams can act on
* Work through ambiguity and make prioritisation calls with incomplete information


**Delivery \& Launch**
* Drive features through development, coordinating across engineering, design, and QA to keep work unblocked
* Define launch plans and success criteria for new features
* Track adoption post\-launch and respond to bugs or gaps in collaboration with the relevant teams


**API \& Technical Collaboration**
* Partner with engineering to define and review API contracts, ensuring product requirements translate accurately into technical specifications
* Evaluate API capabilities and constraints as an input to roadmap and integration decisions


**Sales Enablement**
* Help articulate the value proposition of your product areas for the sales team
* Contribute to and review sales documentation that supports the selling process


**What We're Looking For**
* 2–5 years of product management experience in a product\-led company
* Hands\-on experience working with APIs — either defining requirements for API products or collaborating closely with engineering on API design and documentation
* Domain experience in one or more of: rewards, gift cards, e\-commerce, payments, or fintech
* Demonstrated ability to write clear product requirements and drive them through a development process
* Experience working cross\-functionally with engineering, design, sales, and support teams
* Comfort with both technical conversations and business\-level discussions
* Strong written and verbal communication skills


**Nice to Have**
* Experience across multiple domains within rewards, gift cards, e\-commerce, payments, and fintech
* Exposure to CMS, iPaaS, or integration products


**What Makes You a Strong Fit**
* You move between strategic thinking and detailed specification without losing either
* You hold your own in technical discussions — including API\-level conversations — while staying focused on user and business outcomes
* You build credibility with engineers and designers through clarity and follow\-through, not authority
* You treat customer feedback as signal, not noise, and know how to weight it against other inputs
* You stay calm when priorities shift, and help the teams around you do the same


**Why This Role Matters**
 Product managers at Plum shape what gets built, how it gets positioned, and whether it actually works for customers. This role has direct influence over the roadmap and the quality of execution behind it. The decisions made here affect the product's competitiveness and the experience of every customer using Plum.
   

  

**Why Join Us**
* Work directly with technology, design, sales, and customer care teams in a cross\-functional setup
* Report to the Head of Product Development with visibility into product\-level decisions
* Own a meaningful slice of the roadmap from day one
* Operate in a domain — rewards, gift cards, and commerce — where the product surface is broad and the problems are real
* Join a team that values clear thinking and execution over noise

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
   

  

 Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.
   

  

 People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
   

  

**About The Role**
 HackerRank's goal is straightforward: to give companies a dependable way to evaluate whether a candidate can do the job. The previous model, which relied on test cases and code correctness, is becoming less reliable as candidates use AI assistants and produce work that requires deeper scrutiny.
   

  

 The Evaluation team is rebuilding the underlying scoring system. This involves defining the new evaluation rubrics, determining how our models apply them consistently across thousands of candidates, working with enterprise clients to define good performance, and ensuring our methodology is fair and defensible.
   

  

 Evaluation's trustworthiness is fundamental to HackerRank's business and its products. We are looking to hire a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to own this crucial charter.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own the evaluation product roadmap: what gets built, in what order, and why, with a clear point of view on what the product needs to become over the next 12 to 18 months.
* Define what "good evaluation" means in product terms: the rubrics, scoring dimensions, bias safeguards, and consistency checks that enterprise customers will stake hiring decisions on.
* Work directly with ML engineers and AI researchers to translate methodology into shipped product. You are the connective tissue between research clarity and engineering execution.
* Talk to enterprise customers regularly. Understand how Goldman Sachs defines a strong candidate differently from how a startup does, and make sure the product can serve both.
* Build the feedback loops that let the evaluation system improve: how we capture when customers disagree with a score, what signals we surface to the ML team, and how we close the loop.
* Define and own the metrics that tell us whether evaluation quality is actually improving, not just whether we shipped something.


**Who You Are**
* You have 5 or more years of product experience, with meaningful time in a B2B or enterprise context where your work had to be defensible to sophisticated customers.
* You think rigorously about if the measures actually map to the outcomes. A PM who cannot tell the difference between a good metric and a vanity metric will not survive this role.
* You are comfortable with ambiguity in the problem definition. The answer to "what does good evaluation look like" does not exist yet. You need to want to find it, not wait for someone to hand it to you.
* You can hold your own in a technical conversation with ML engineers without needing to code. You understand enough about model behavior, evaluation pipelines, and data feedback loops to ask sharp questions.
* You communicate with precision. Crisp PRDs, sharp debate in design reviews, clear framing to customers and leadership. You do not hide behind vague language when the problem is hard.


**Even better if you have**
* Prior experience in assessment, ed\-tech, talent tech, or any domain where you had to build products around subjective or qualitative evaluation.
* Exposure to fairness, bias, or compliance considerations in a product context.
* Experience building or working closely with ML\-powered scoring or ranking systems.
* Track record of defining new product categories rather than iterating on established ones.


**You will thrive if you**
* Believe the evaluation problem is one of the most interesting unsolved problems in enterprise software right now.
* You want to own a roadmap that is genuinely consequential, not increment on features that already exist.
* Are the kind of PM who would rather have a sharp conversation about what we should not build than ship something that does not hold up. You are not scared of technical depth. You lean into it.


**Want to learn more about HackerRank?** 
 Check out HackerRank.com to explore our products, solutions and resources, and dive into our story and mission here.
   

  

 HackerRank is a proud equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. We provide equal opportunity to everyone for employment based on individual performance and qualification. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Linkedin \| X \| Blog \| Instagram \| Life@HackerRank
   

  

**Notice To Prospective HackerRank Job Applicants**
* Our Recruiters use @hackerrank.com email addresses.
* We never ask for payment or credit check information to apply, interview, or work here.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working through complex credit and operational logic, translating business and risk requirements into scalable product experiences, and improving how small businesses discover, qualify for, accept, and manage financing through Bluevine.
   

  

 The platform and systems in this domain are mission\-critical: they determine which customers are eligible for financing, how offers are generated and displayed, how applications move through underwriting, how partner lenders receive data, and how internal teams manage exceptions, statuses, communications, and follow\-up workflows.

* Conduct business discovery and gather requirements from a broad set of internal stakeholders, including risk, back\-office operations, accounting, finance, and legal compliance teams
* Define detailed technical specifications for new features and projects, outlining business requirements, acceptance criteria, and system design considerations — serving as a precise guide for engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle
* Partner closely with R\&D and QA teams through sprint planning and execution, conducting UAT before production deployments and driving issues and bugs to resolution
* Monitor and maintain mission\-critical systems across payments, accounting, and capital markets — ensuring data accuracy, integrating with banks and vendors, and enhancing internal operational tools for efficiency and scalability

jobs.description:
Job Description: **Job Description**

  

We are looking for an exceptional Technical Project Manager (TPM) to manage and drive next generation offers in our portfolio of energy storage and EVSE product lines. In this position, the successful candidate will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving execution of technically complex programs in alignment with technical and business goals. The candidate will a member of the Technical Project Management group, working in close collaboration with engineering, product owners, industrialization and supply chain, business stakeholders and peer TPMs.

  

We are looking for a positive, confident, self\-motivated, passionate individual with a strong desire to work in an exciting, fast\-paced, team\-based collaborative design environment to help us innovate our existing technologies to empower and connect our products to each other, and to our customers.

  

If you are interested in battery\-based energy storage systems, electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure, cloud\-connected systems, have strong aspirations for both independent and collaborative product development, and are excited about contributing to a world\-class product, then this is the position for you.

 **What will you do?**

* **Driving Strategic Alignment**: TPMs work with product, engineering and operations leadership to develop timelines, roadmaps and goals and ensure initiatives support business objectives. Co\-ordinate and ensure collaboration and high productivity across teams.

* **Orchestrate and manage technical execution**:
	+ Lead the project team through the Offer Creation Process \- defining, scoping and executing the deliverables and collaborative activities throughout the phases of the offer lifecycle.
	+ Build and maintain the detailed project schedule with work breakdown structures and defined milestones, managing dependencies and aligning roadmaps. Coordinate across multiple technical disciplines (HW, FW, SW, Mechanical, and Compliance) and cross\-functional groups to define scope and deliverables for each feature and/or requirements.
	+ Anticipate risks, surface trade\-offs, and coordinate across teams. Identify critical paths or resource deficiencies and escalate to functional managers and leadership.
	+ Organize sprints and critical planning meetings. Using frameworks like Agile, Scrum Waterfall or hybrids, TPMs track progress of the workstreams and their milestones, run stand\-ups or steering meetings, and escalate risks.
	+ Lead and conduct all technical reviews in collaboration with Chief Engineers, drive Go / No\-Go decisions for product change requests (PCRs).
	+ Use collaboration tools like Jira, Confluence and JAMA, to help maintain visibility of workstreams and documentation, and keep teams on track.
	+ Ensure requirements are developed timely and of high quality, from marketing to systems to subsystems, to aid design teams in efficient and focused development that drives customer satisfaction and business growth.

* **Cross\-Team Synchronization**: TPMs act as the single point of accountability for the program team. They coordinate sprint plans, facilitate signoffs, and ensure teams are ready for launch, preventing friction across departments. Collaborate with product owners, chief engineers and cross\-functional leads for effective planning and reporting.

* **Stakeholder Communication and Trust\-Building**: TPMs deliver tailored updates, such as architectural summaries and development schedules for tech leads, development progress and demo readiness for product owners, and executive summaries and deep dive discussions for leadership. By proactively managing expectations, they foster trust and alignment across the organization. TPMs represent the voice of engineering and the program to the organization.

* **Continuous Improvement:** Define, develop strategy, best practices, processes, and tools for technical program management, in collaboration with peer TPMs and other departments.

 **What qualifications will make you successful?**

* 5\+ years of strong multi\-disciplinary experience in design and development across electronics hardware, embedded systems, firmware and mechanical engineering.
* 2\+ years of technical leadership experience with proven track record of managing complex, cross\-functional programs from concept through execution in hardware\-software integrated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to dive into technical issues and support teams in identifying root causes, trade\-offs, and timely mitigations.
* Strong project schedule management skills with detailed work breakdowns and risk management
* Sound business and technical acumen, and ability to prioritize work as appropriate.
* Fosters team collaboration and strives for continuous improvement.
* Attention to detail, critical and analytical thinker, strong problem\-solving skills, proactive and decisive in a fast\-paced work environment to keep programs on track for scope and schedule.
* Knowledge of agile methodology. Leadership and stakeholder participation in all agile activities including, but not limited to, scrums, sprint planning and retrospectives.
* Excellent communication skills with transparency and accountability. Driven and able to complete work autonomously and lead teams under pressure.
* Previous experience in a dynamic work environment with global teams spread across multiple time zones.
* Hands\-on experience with collaboration tools such as JIRA, Confluence and JAMA
* Familiarity with interconnection standards, safety and certification requirements (e.g., UL 9540, IEEE 1547, NEC), and regulatory frameworks (e.g., FERC, NERC, state\-level energy policy).

jobs.title: Associate Director, MRM Validation Lead
jobs.description:
**Some careers have more impact than others**.


If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Associate Director, MRM Validation Lead****.**

**Model Risk Management**

* Model Risk Management (MRM) at HSBC is structured as a global function, headed up by the Chief Model Risk Officer (CMRO). The MRM function reports directly to the Group Chief Risk and Compliance Officer (GCRCO) ensuring its independence from the model developing and owning areas of the firm. MRM are the second line of defence (2LoD) for Model Risk and the CMRO is the global Model Risk Steward for the group and is also accountable for the global operation of the MRM function. MRM teams are based in each region, to ensure local subject matter expertise and to guide, review, and challenge. MRM activity is managed on a global basis as many models are used in multiple locations. This enables MRM to operate consistently and efficiently globally, and to take account of additional local regulatory requirements.
* Model Risk Governance \- Setting the firm's model risk policies and standards, ensuring that model risk is managed within the approved tolerance levels, providing second line assurance on the implementation of policy, and monitoring regulatory developments impacting model risk.
* Model Risk Stewardship \- Facilitating responsible development, understanding and use of models and analytics, as well as providing subject matter expertise, advice, guidance, and effective challenge across all entities, regions, global businesses, and functions.
* Independent Model Validation\- Independently reviewing and (re)validating models, providing an objective, unbiased and critical opinion on the suitability and soundness of models for their intended use and the accuracy, relevance and completeness of outputs used to inform business decisions.
* Independent Model Validation is a specialist quantitative role within the Model Risk Management team responsible for carrying out independent validations of HSBC’s model landscape, in order to identify and communicate model limitations and issues. Independent Model Validation provides independent challenge of a model’s underlying theoretical assumptions and limitations, its practical implementation, its live application and business usage, providing stakeholders (including model users, senior management, audit and regulators) with assurance that models and tools developed, maintained and used within HSBC Group are fit for their intended purposes and are compliant with applicable internal and supervisory expectations. They will also review remediation plans and activities, undertake portfolio level reviews across model types and challenge the model owners on the appropriate application of relevant policy of models.
* Model types include but are not limited to Credit Risk models (Retail and Wholesale)\- IRB/IFRS9 models, Stress Testing and Scenario Analysis models, Economic Capital models, Financial Vulnerability models, Pricing models, Traded Risk models, Insurance Risk models and models covering non\-financial areas e.g., transaction monitoring, customer selection and human resources. This includes the traditional model types as well as modern approaches such as machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) techniques.
* This job description is for **Market Risk model validation.**

**In this role, you will:**

* Undertake measures to independently execute end\-to\-end model validations as dictated by the Global Model Risk Policy including the assessment of model inputs, calculations, reporting outputs, conceptual soundness of the underlying theory and the suitability of the use for its intended purpose, relevance and completeness of data, qualitative information and judgements, documentation, and implementation of the model.
* Design, develop, and execute testing frameworks, tailored to specific model complexities to identify risks and limitations. Develop and implement advanced validation methodologies and tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the validation process.
* Responsible for ensuring the execution of model validation projects within their functional stream, ensuring timely delivery and quality of work. Contribute to the continuous improvement of validation processes and methodologies, suggesting enhancements and opportunities to streamline processes.
* Lead discussions and negotiate with model developers and business owners regarding validation outcomes including identified issues and limitations, remediation actions, and when required defending validation conclusions effectively.
* Guide the interaction with Group Internal Audit on model related audits, MSIIs and audit issues.
* Proactively participate in strategic initiatives for MRM, being a champion of changes and proactively making suggestions for improvements. Collaborate closely with senior managers in Global Businesses and Functions in order to plan, prioritise and deliver model risk management activities that are aligned with business strategic goals and priorities, whilst ensuring strong second line independence and oversight is maintained.
* Guide the Global Model Risk Steward by ensuring that potential model risk issues, impacts to risk appetite, internal and external audit findings and regulatory issues are managed appropriately and escalated in a timely manner as required.Guide the preparation and delivery of model risk management opinions and papers for inclusion in first and second line senior governance forums, including Country/Regional\…

 Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6\.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by

 , who today remains the company’s Chairman and CTO.

 Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors.
